title: Modifier definitions
intro: Define how custom modifier values are shown and where they are available.
noSearchResults: No modifier definitions match this search
emptyDescription: Add a typed custom value that scripts can read with modifier@modifier_id.
selectDescription: Choose an item on the left to edit its display rules.
editorDescription: These fields are emitted to common/modifier_definitions and are not ordinary modifier effects. The structured editor preserves meaning, not original comments or formatting; files outside its safe subset stay verbatim in Raw Files.
modifierIdHint: Use letters, numbers, and underscores. Scripts read it as modifier@modifier_id.
colorTypeHint: Controls whether positive values are presented as good, bad, or neutral.
valueTypeHint: Choose a number, percentage, hundred-based percentage, or yes/no value.
postfixHint: Optionally show the value as days, hours, or a daily rate.
categoriesHint: Choose one or more contexts. The last selected category cannot be removed.
